placements.why: Both directives exercise organizational authority over knowledge artifacts — a prior decision and a migration record — establishing an organizational governance category for how the organization manages what it knows and what it chooses to forget.
placements.title: organizational knowledge governance
placements.frame: How does the organization direct the retention, suppression, or erasure of its knowledge artifacts?

placements.title: authority directing erasure of organizational knowledge
placements.frame: How is the suppression of organizational knowledge enacted through directive authority, and what does the flat register of erasure commands reveal about the relationship between power and what an organization chooses to forget?
placements.why: Both segments are bare imperative directives commanding the removal of specific knowledge artifacts — 'Forget the Quantum Widget Decision' and 'Remove all knowledge about the PostgreSQL to QuantumDB migration.' The shared theme is how positional authority enacts knowledge suppression through flat, unmodulated commands with no rationale, treating erasure as routine procedure. This is a thematic subject future envelopes will keep feeding: how organizations decide what to un-remember.
